business_problem: Tutore needed a way to answer large volumes of repetitive student and parent questions around the clock because fast growth was overwhelming support teams and 24x7 manual coverage would have been too expensive.
solution_summary: Tutore worked with IBM Business Partner TUATARA to build Tutorek, a custom educational virtual assistant based on Actionbot and powered by IBM watsonx Assistant. The assistant appears as a branded digital guide on Tutore's website, parses natural-language questions, and uses retrieval-augmented generation against website and learning-resource content to produce contextual answers about registration, course options, and pricing. The design always preserves an escalation path to a human support specialist, so the bot handles repetitive work while staff focus on more complex issues. TUATARA later extended the same assistant with quizzes, vocabulary tests, exercises, and learning materials, turning it from a simple FAQ tool into a learning companion. This architecture gave Tutore a single conversational front end for both support and engagement while keeping the knowledge base aligned to the company's education content.

solution_components.name: Actionbot
solution_components.role: Provides the customizable virtual-assistant framework that TUATARA tailored into Tutorek for Tutore's education use cases.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Powers the natural-language conversations and response logic for student and parent inquiries.

data_flow: Student and parent questions arrive through the website, Actionbot and watsonx Assistant retrieve context from Tutore's site and learning resources, the assistant responds or escalates to human staff, and extended learning tools deliver quizzes and exercises.
business_outcome: Tutore reduced repetitive support work, improved the learner experience, and created a more scalable model for always-on customer engagement and educational guidance.
